close_reason: Delivered in PR #253 (audited 2026-09-06: real bug; key_count_delta replaces stat tracking, key_bounds/1 on demand, n_keys rewinds; 10 tests; CI green). Unmarked-modified pages tracked in bedrock-5yg.
description: During bedrock-eu4 work: IndexManager.info(:n_keys) stays 0 after applying transactions (IndexUpdate.track_statistics defaults false, and finish/1 discards counts), and :key_ranges reports sentinel {<<0xFF,0xFF>>, ""} even with data. Possibly a latent accounting bug around keys_added - keys_removed (index_manager.ex:197). Needs a targeted test + decision.

comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/253 — valid bug, fixed. n_keys was never incremented (track_statistics defaulted false and nothing set it) while range clears decremented unconditionally, so it only fell and went negative (-2 on a fresh index); key_ranges reported the empty sentinel because Index.min_key/max_key were cached at load and never maintained. Fixed by deriving an exact key_count_delta from the page counts the segment merge already returns, and computing key bounds on demand. Two further rewind points (compaction cutover, rollback_to/2) also needed the count rewound with the index. Cold audit PASS-WITH-NOTES; all four findings addressed.

title: Investigate IndexManager n_keys/key_ranges accounting staying at defaults
